图像URL地址。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见[文件URL处理](~~155645~~)。

> - 推荐新版本调用方式为只输入图片，当只传入ImageURL的时候所有接口数据都会返回，新版本支持返回最多10张人脸的数据。

- 兼容老版本接口对布尔值入参和MaxFaceNumber的支持逻辑，当传入任意一个支持的布尔值入参或MaxFaceNumber以控制返回的数据时，只会返回设置了布尔值入参且为true的数据，这种调用方式不返回布尔值入参支持范围外的数据（Landmarks，LandmarkCount，PoseList，Pupils）。
description.en:
The image URL address. We recommend using OSS links in the Shanghai region. For files stored locally or OSS links in regions other than Shanghai, see [File URL Processing](~~155645~~).

> - The recommended calling method for the new version is to input only the image. When only ImageURL is passed, all API data will be returned. The new version supports returning data for up to 10 faces.

- Compatible with old version interface support logic for boolean input parameters and MaxFaceNumber. When any supported boolean input parameter or MaxFaceNumber is passed to control the returned data, only the data for which boolean input parameters are set to true will be returned. This calling method does not return data outside the scope of boolean input parameters (Landmarks, LandmarkCount, PoseList, Pupils).

description.en: Compatible with old version interface. Used to set the maximum number of faces to return from the image. Valid values: 1 to 10. Default value: 1. To return multiple face detection results, set this parameter correctly. By default, results are sorted in descending order by the FaceProbabilityList return parameter.

descriptions.zh:
## 功能描述
人脸属性识别能力可以识别检测人脸的性别、年龄、表情、眼镜、帽子五种属性，支持人脸遮挡、光照、模糊度、姿态、噪声综合质量评分，支持检测含有多张人脸的照片属性判断。

> - 您可以进入[在线咨询](https://www.aliyun.com/core/online-consult?from=aZgW6LJHr2)获取在线人工帮助。
- 当前能力可在视觉智能开放平台有完整的免费产品体验，您可以单击[立即试用](https://vision.aliyun.com/experience/detail?&tagName=facebody&children=RecognizeFace)对该能力进行更直观试用以及在线购买。
- 阿里云视觉智能开放平台视觉AI能力API接入、接口使用或问题咨询等，请通过钉钉群（23109592）加入阿里云视觉智能开放平台咨询群联系我们。

## 特色优势

- 适应能力强：不同照片、人脸尺寸多场景下，覆盖多个年龄段识别。
- 图片质量打分：支持人脸遮挡、光照、模糊度、姿态、噪声综合质量评分。
- 平台服务稳定：提供在高并发，大流量下的毫秒级识别响应和保障。

## 接入指引
1. 注册阿里云账号：打开[阿里云官网](https://www.aliyun.com)，在阿里云官网右上角，单击**立即注册**，按照操作提示完成账号注册。
2. 开通能力：请确保您已开通[人脸人体服务](https://vision.aliyun.com/facebody)，若未开通服务请[立即开通](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=viapi_facebody_public_cn#/open)。
> 本能力支持企业或个人认证用户开通。更多实名认证操作信息，请参见[实名认证](https://help.aliyun.com/knowledge_list/37170.html)。
3. 创建AccessKey：请确保您已[创建AccessKey](~~175144~~)，如果您使用的是子账号AccessKey，您需要给子账号赋予AliyunVIAPIFullAccess权限，具体操作，请参见[RAM授权](~~145025~~)。
4. 在线调试（可选）：您可以通过[OpenAPI Explorer](https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/facebody/2019-12-30/RecognizeFace?lang=JAVA&sdkStyle=dara&params=%7B%22ImageURL%22%3A%22http%3A%2F%2Fviapi-test.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com%2Fviapi-3.0domepic%2Ffacebody%2FRecognizeFace%2FRecognizeFace1.png%22%7D&tab=DEMO)在线调试能力，查看完整的调用示例代码及SDK依赖信息，也可以下载完整的工程。
5. 开发接入步骤：
- 在[SDK总览](~~145033~~)中选择您要接入使用的SDK语言。
- 在对应语言的SDK文档中找到AI类目为人脸人体（facebody）的SDK包进行安装。
- 参考文档中提供的示例代码进行适当修改后调用。

6. 示例代码：该能力常用语言的示例代码，请参见[人脸属性识别示例代码](~~465558~~)。
7. 客户端直接调用：该能力常用的客户端调用方式包括以下几种。
- [Web前端直接调用](~~467779~~)
- [小程序场景下直接调用](~~467780~~)
- [Android端直接调用](~~467781~~)
- [iOS端直接调用](~~467782~~)

## 输入限制

- 图像格式：JPEG、JPG、PNG、BMP。
- 图像大小：不超过20 MB。
- 图像分辨率：大于32×32像素，小于4096×4096像素，人脸占比不低于64×64像素。
- URL地址中不能包含中文字符。

> 当图像分辨率超过最大限制时，请先将图片进行缩放，调整图片大小，具体请参见[图片缩放](~~44688~~)。

## 计费说明
关于人脸属性识别的计费方式及报价，请参见[计费介绍](~~184049~~)。
> 下方调试接口为付费接口，如需免费体验调试请前往[体验中心](https://vision.aliyun.com/experience/detail?&tagName=facebody&children=RecognizeFace)。
descriptions.en:
## Feature Description
The Face Attribute Recognition capability can detect and identify five face attributes including gender, age, expression, glasses, and hat. It supports comprehensive quality scoring for face occlusion, illumination, blur, pose, and noise, and supports attribute detection for photos containing multiple faces.

> - You can visit [Online Consultation](https://www.aliyun.com/core/online-consult?from=aZgW6LJHr2) for online assistance.
- This capability offers a complete free product experience on the Visual Intelligence Open Platform. You can click [Try Now](https://vision.aliyun.com/experience/detail?&tagName=facebody&children=RecognizeFace) for a more intuitive trial and online purchase.
- For Alibaba Cloud Visual Intelligence Open Platform visual AI capability API access, interface usage, or consultation, please join the Alibaba Cloud Visual Intelligence Open Platform consultation group through DingTalk group (23109592) to contact us.

## Key Advantages

- Strong adaptability: Supports recognition across different photos, face sizes, and multiple scenarios, covering multiple age groups.
- Image quality scoring: Supports comprehensive quality scoring for face occlusion, illumination, blur, pose, and noise.
- Stable platform service: Provides millisecond-level recognition response and guarantee under high concurrency and large traffic.

## Access Guide
1. Register an Alibaba Cloud account: Open the [Alibaba Cloud official website](https://www.aliyun.com). In the upper-right corner of the Alibaba Cloud official website, click **Register Now** and follow the instructions to complete account registration.
2. Activate the capability: Make sure you have activated the [Face and Body service](https://vision.aliyun.com/facebody). If you have not activated the service, please [activate it now](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=viapi_facebody_public_cn#/open).
> This capability is available for enterprise or individual verified users. For more information about real-name verification, see [Real-name Verification](https://help.aliyun.com/knowledge_list/37170.html).
3. Create an AccessKey: Make sure you have [created an AccessKey](~~175144~~). If you are using a RAM user AccessKey, you need to grant the AliyunVIAPIFullAccess permission to the RAM user. For more information, see [RAM Authorization](~~145025~~).
4. Online debugging (optional): You can use [OpenAPI Explorer](https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/facebody/2019-12-30/RecognizeFace?lang=JAVA&sdkStyle=dara&params=%7B%22ImageURL%22%3A%22http%3A%2F%2Fviapi-test.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com%2Fviapi-3.0domepic%2Ffacebody%2FRecognizeFace%2FRecognizeFace1.png%22%7D&tab=DEMO) for online debugging, view complete sample code and SDK dependency information, or download the complete project.
5. Development integration steps:
- Select the SDK language you want to use from the [SDK Overview](~~145033~~).
- Find and install the SDK package with the AI category of Face and Body (facebody) in the corresponding language's SDK documentation.
- Refer to the sample code provided in the documentation, make appropriate modifications, and call the API.

6. Sample code: For sample code in commonly used languages for this capability, see [Face Attribute Recognition Sample Code](~~465558~~).
7. Direct client invocation: Common client calling methods for this capability include the following.
- [Direct Web Frontend Invocation](~~467779~~)
- [Direct Invocation in Mini Program Scenarios](~~467780~~)
- [Direct Android Invocation](~~467781~~)
- [Direct iOS Invocation](~~467782~~)

## Input Limitations

- Image formats: JPEG, JPG, PNG, BMP.
- Image size: No larger than 20 MB.
- Image resolution: Greater than 32×32 pixels and less than 4096×4096 pixels. The face area must be no smaller than 64×64 pixels.
- The URL must not contain Chinese characters.

> When the image resolution exceeds the maximum limit, please scale the image first. For more information, see [Image Scaling](~~44688~~).

## Billing
For the billing method and pricing of Face Attribute Recognition, see [Billing Overview](~~184049~~).
> The debugging interface below is a paid interface. For free trial debugging, please go to the [Experience Center](https://vision.aliyun.com/experience/detail?&tagName=facebody&children=RecognizeFace).
